# PDF.js 6.5.438

Distribution files from `pdfjs-dist@6.5.438`, distributed under Apache-2.0. See [PDFJS-LICENSE.txt](PDFJS-LICENSE.txt) and the [upstream release](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.5.438).

The module and worker are served by the application as local assets. Application code uses PDF.js only to read text and form fields. To keep the repository change inside the cases feature, both assets are included here. The two modules differ from the distribution only by a lint directive and removal of the source map reference.
